# PackT

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

*This is a test package that I am using to work on my tool dev skills

## Installation

You can install the development version of PackT from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("amontanarofish/PackT")
```

## Example

Basic CRW example with plot showing the nearest point to a set point in space (always 30,50):

```{r example}
library(PackT)
sim <- simulate_crw()
plot_crw(sim)
```
